The more significant improvement in strength properties ( σ uts = 1.13 GPa, H μ = 2.67 GPa) of the TNZ alloy and, consequently, decrease in its ductility and Young ’ s modulus, are due to additional hardening contribution of the α -phase.

It has been found that multicomponent (Nb, Zr, Ta, Sn) alloying of the TNZTS alloy stabilizes the β -phase and does not reduce its ductility and Young ’ s modulus. Nevertheless, the increase in its strength properties ( σ uts = 0.78 GPa, H μ = 2.4 GPa) turns out to be less significant.
